comparison.objective: Lower a closed frame over a post and seat it level without contact; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual transport, centering, clearance maintenance, and level seating.
comparison.success_condition: Frame clears the post and satisfies centering, seating-height, and tilt criteria; exact thresholds are omitted.
comparison.reason: Collision-free frame placement tests geometric clearance, not tool-mediated impact fracture and containment of released pieces.
